## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this solve? What use case are you trying to address?

Example: "As a developer using Drizzle ORM, I have to write a custom error adapter every project to handle constraint violations. A built-in Drizzle adapter would save time."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Include API design if relevant:

```js
// How you'd want to use it
res.success(data, "Done", { someNewOption: true });
```

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you've already considered and why you ruled them out.

## Additional Context

Any other context, links to related issues, or examples from other libraries.
